name: Edward VII
role: King of the United Kingdom and the British Dominions, Emperor of India (1901-1910)
summary: A constitutional monarch whose record is mostly ministers' policy, with limited political writing of his own. His recorded views include opposition to Irish Home Rule, to women's suffrage and to protectionism, sympathy for trade unions and housing reform, and strong support for the navy and army reform. He sought to keep the House of Lords largely intact during the 1909-10 crisis.

sources.title: King Edward VII: A Biography, vol. 1 (From Birth to Accession)
sources.author: Sidney Lee (quotes Edward's letters and 1884 Lords speech)
sources.usedFor: Letters and speeches as Prince of Wales: Home Rule, housing commission, trade unions, women, India.

sources.title: King Edward VII: A Biography, vol. 2 (The Reign)

sources.usedFor: Reign-era letters: suffragettes, free trade, Dreadnoughts, 1909 Budget, Lords reform proposal, Ireland.
